Cohesive premium handmade editorial still life, tactile matte wood and paper, cream background, forest green shadows, restrained warm brass accents, soft directional studio light. Objects centered in the middle 70% of image, generous breathing room; readable when cropped to 16:9 in a blog card. Refined and welcoming, lively color accents, not dark or cluttered. No lettering, no logo, no watermark, no people.
